title: Minepanel Moderation [Addon]
description: Help with server moderation, plugin includes ad blocker, swear filter, spam filter, staffchat, reports and a webpanel
body:
Bring simpler moderation to your server than ever. This plugin has a very easy to configure spam, ad and chat filter. But also brings a report system all done through the web interface of [Minepanel - Server Analytics](https://modrinth.com/plugin/minepanel-server-analytics). This hooks into that plugin giving you a new page with all the moderation tools. 

## Showcase

![Page Overview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/699c5184d66e898cd011ca84080836c5dee2a709.png)

![Detection modules and Chat filter](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/05fa6f0e58ceab1be280b537845ddfadb5550667.png)

![Report Information](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1f417acfb58dc88b14fb9d77a6298a3f444ebab_0.webp)


## Features

**Clean Web Interface** - Integrated with plugin features for easy moderation.

**Player Reports** - Reporting players for different reasons, with not taking for staff and report closing.

**Chat Filter** - Filter Chat messages for swearwords

**Advertisement Filter** - Filter out IPs, Links etc...

**CAPS Filter** - Stop players from flooding the chat with caps filter. Can configure % of chat containing caps for better configuration.

**Chat Slowmode** - Turn on slowmode so players cannot spam the chat in important events. Staff can bypass.

**Staff Chat** - Send message between the staff.

**Admin Chat** - Send message between the admins.

**Clear Chat** - Clean the chat

## Permissions

**moderation.chatclear** - Clear the Chat

**moderation.slowmode** - Turn on slow mode

**moderation.staffchat** - Allow using and viewing staffchat

**moderation.adminchat** - Allow using and viewing adminchat

**moderation.notify** - Receive staff notifications on new reports, filtered messages

**moderation.bypass.slowmode** - Bypass slowmode

**moderation.bypass.filter** - Bypass the filters

## Requirements (dependencies)

**MinePanel** - Required for the plugin to work and to use the web interface. [Install Here](https://modrinth.com/plugin/minepanel-server-analytics)
